user.title: BoilerJuice account
user.description: Sign in with your BoilerJuice account. Every tank on the account is added; you can narrow that down afterwards under Reconfigure.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to BoilerJuice again
reauth_confirm.description: BoilerJuice is no longer accepting the stored password for {email}.

reconfigure.title: BoilerJuice settings
reconfigure.description: Leave the password blank to keep the current one.

error.no_tanks: That BoilerJuice account has no tanks set up

abort.already_configured: That BoilerJuice account is already configured
abort.reconfigure_successful: The BoilerJuice settings have been updated

reset_consumption.name: Reset Consumption
reset_consumption.description: Reset the consumption counters, history and references to zero, and clear any manual daily consumption override.

set_consumption.name: Set Consumption
set_consumption.description: Manually set the consumption values for the oil tank.

daily.name: Daily Consumption
daily.description: Optional daily consumption override in litres per day. It replaces the measured rate and persists across updates and restarts until you run "Reset consumption".

invalid_stored_data.title: BoilerJuice consumption history was reset
invalid_stored_data.description: The stored BoilerJuice consumption history could not be read and has been discarded, so consumption counting has restarted from zero ({reason}). Current tank readings are unaffected. If you know your previous total, you can restore it with the "Set consumption" action.
